Executive Summary

Headline performance across the two-year period, with management KPIs shown prominently. Average profit margin is calculated as total profit divided by total revenue for decision-useful portfolio profitability.

Revenue grew in 2024. Annual revenue moved from $632,219 in 2023 to $643,089 in 2024, a 1.7% change; orders changed 1.5%.
Profit expanded alongside revenue. Profit changed 1.6% year over year, with 2024 margin at 40.0% versus 40.1% in 2023.
Concentration is moderate. Top 10 products account for 5.8% of revenue; top 10 stores account for 11.0%.
Discounts require guardrails. The highest discount band posts a 40.0% margin versus 40.0% for non-discounted orders, a -0.0% margin gap.
